messages: anya: Quick design review — putting the new 'Bootflow' welcome strip + sample-projects carousel up for copy + a11y pass before Fri demo. Link to Figma: https://figma.redwood/bootflow :eyes: matt: ack. Can you drop the copy variants here? I want to pick a CTA by EOD so we can freeze the banner treatment for the demo. anya: Variant A: "Get started in seconds" / Sub: "Try one of our sample projects to see real latency & cost stats." Variant B: "Create your first workspace" / Sub: "Start from a curated template — demo tokens included." Variant C (concise): "Try a sample project" / Sub: "No credit card — instant run." (sharing screenshot — banner with CTA + three pill sample cards) sam: front-end notes: carousel should be swipeable on mobile, and pillars collapse to a vertical stack under 560px. Also need to confirm the banner doesn't push down the quickstart command copy when the user has an empty workspace. :point_up: lou: a11y quick pass: contrast on Variant B CTA is borderline at small sizes (AA fail at 14px). Focus ring currently uses 2px blur shadow — recommend a 3px solid outline or change color. Also the sample cards need role="listitem" inside role="list" and each card should have an aria-describedby link to the microcopy. Add aria-live="polite" for the success toast when they run sample. anya: good catches. for the CTA contrast I can try darkening the CTA background by 8%. I'll add an explicit focus style in the prototype. shirley: also note localization: Variant A is ~ 32 chars; in German it expands ~35%. Make sure CTA doesn't truncate in the compact banner. Can we allow two-line CTAs? matt: preference leaning to Variant A for tone — more action-y. But if it breaks layout in other langs let's fallback to B. Could we do adaptive copy: long locales use "Create your first workspace"? We should avoid JS complexity in the demo though. anya: proposal: use Variant A for en/us, Variant B for others in demo build. For production we can ship a fallback that shortens to "Try sample" when space < 240px. sam: implementation idea: use CSS clamp on font-size + display: inline-flex; allow CTA to wrap to two lines with center alignment. For the carousel we can lazy-load images and keep card height stable to avoid layout shift. Also will add tabindex="0" on each card and arrow-key handlers for keyboard nav. lou: keyboard nav note: ensure left/right arrows don't conflict with nested interactive elements. Recommend that arrow keys move focus between cards only when the focus is on the carousel container, otherwise let native defaults apply. Add skip link to skip carousel for screen reader users: Skip sample carousel. ci-bot: deploy-preview created for bootflow-banner-a11y (pr/888) — netlify preview: https://preview.redwood/pr-888 anya: thanks @ci-bot — I'll pull the preview and run through voiceover. Can someone help check the success toast wording when they run a sample? I think current: "Sample project deployed — open workspace" feels abrupt. matt: suggestion: "Sample ready — open your workspace" or "You're all set — open workspace". The softer "You're all set" might be friendlier for new users. lou: prefer explicit confirmation for assistive tech: include the resource name, e.g., "Sample 'TodoMVC' is ready. Open workspace." That helps context when the screen reader reads multiple toasts. anya: ok will update to "Sample 'TodoMVC' is ready — open workspace" in the toast and add aria-live="polite". Also added a short description under the CTA explaining billing: "Free demo tokens included — usage billed only after you remove demo flag." shirley: small nit on microcopy: change "demo tokens" to "trial tokens" — legal prefers that phrasing for external copy. anya: noted, switching to "trial tokens". I'll push new copy to the figma and update the PR. matt: timeline check — can we freeze copy + basic a11y fixes by Thu 3pm so eng can polish for Fri demo? sam: yes I can land the keyboard nav + focus styles by Thu noon if copy is final by Wed EOD. anya: will finalize copy + figma updates today. Thanks all :raised_hands:
